4 MapSketch include sketch showing the t: North-oriented map of a 5.0-mile radius centered on BNSF Railway Milepost 218.4 near Skykomish, Washington. Five freight cars derailed at the primary site, including chlorine tank car DOT-105J500W BNSF-77402 with damaged valve housing. A 1,500-foot vapor zone affects the right-of-way and State Route 2. Threatened areas are the Town of Skykomish 1.8 miles West downwind and South Fork Skykomish River salmon habitat 300 feet South. WSP FLIR Helicopter WSP-AIR-2 observed a green-yellow cloud in the ravine moving West-Northwest at 4 mph. No liquid runoff entered waterways; ground contamination is limited to northern ravine slopes. Show Staging Area Charlie at Stevens Pass Maintenance Yard, the Command Post at Skykomish School Gym, a 1.5-mile Exclusion Zone, and Route 2 closure points.
5 Situation Summary and Health and Safet: At 04:15, five cars derailed and chlorine tank car BNSF-77402 sustained dome damage, releasing toxic chlorine vapor at about 15 lb/min. State Route 2 was closed and 250 Skykomish residents were ordered to evacuate. Hazards include pulmonary edema, ocular and skin burns, acute respiratory collapse, hypothermia at 34°F, and steep-terrain falls. Enforce a 1.5-mile Exclusion Zone; require Level A vapor-tight suits with SCBA for Hot Zone entry and Level B suits for Warm Zone support; continuously monitor chlorine at command-post baselines; require outer-perimeter shelter-in-place; and provide heated wet decontamination at Staging Area Charlie.
7 Current and Planned Objectives: Complete evacuation of Skykomish within the 1.5-mile radius by 07:30; perform Level A Hot Zone entry and install an Emergency B-Kit on the chlorine car dome by 09:30; establish multi-point air monitoring along State Route 2 by 08:00; and secure the rail right-of-way and establish Unified Command by 07:00.
